items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: he was ahead of my time... heard of him, heard a lot about him.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the other early colored bands? There was one famous band, Buddy Bolden.

Buddy Bolden. Well, Buddy Bolden came after my, oh, he was ahead of my time. Buddy Bolden, I think, was in his heyday. One I can remember around, well, heard of him, heard a lot about him. But I think he went insane. Yeah, that's right.
I think in 1907, I think is the date. Yeah. So you were still.
